text: {"table": {"name": "transactions_1k", "purpose": "Point-of-sale fuel purchase transactions at gas stations: one row per purchase, recording when it happened, which customer/card made it, at which station, of which product, in what quantity, and at what total price."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "transaction_id", "description": "Primary key; sequential transaction identifier 1-1000.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "date", "name": "transaction_date", "description": "Date of the transaction (stored as text, format YYYY-MM-DD); all rows fall in 2012-08-23 to 2012-08-26.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "date", "name": "transaction_time", "description": "Time of day of the transaction (stored as text, format HH:MM:00).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "customer_id", "description": "Reference to customers.col_001; identifies the customer who made the purchase.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "identifier", "name": "card_id", "description": "Loyalty/payment card number used for the transaction. Not a join key to any known table; values are large 5-6 digit numbers, mostly unique per transaction. Could alternatively be a customer card identifier, but no table links it.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_006": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "gasstation_id", "description": "Reference to gasstations.col_001; identifies the gas station where the purchase occurred.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "product_id", "description": "Reference to products.col_001; identifies the product purchased (fuel type or shop item).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "amount", "description": "Quantity purchased (e.g., liters of fuel or units of product). It joins to products.col_001 only because product IDs and small quantities overlap numerically; the value distribution (0-264, median 19) fits a quantity, not a product reference. Units unconfirmed.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_009": {"role": "numeric", "name": "total_price", "description": "Total price of the transaction in currency units (e.g., euros); consistent with amount x unit price (max 5762.49, median ~354).", "status": "resolved"}}}
